##### Project general facts

Sawa Residences is a striking residential tower where every decision has been shaped around the way people genuinely want to live. The collection spans compact one-bedroom homes, full one-bedroom residences, and generously proportioned two- and three-bedroom apartments, so there is a home here for almost everyone. Rising above a beautifully sculpted podium across twenty residential levels, served by five lifts and two separate entrances, the building feels both effortless and impressively well planned.

Life here is supported by an exceptional spread of amenities, from the main swimming pool, relaxation pool and dedicated kids pool to a sunlit solarium pool deck lined with sunbeds and cabanas. Wellness is wonderfully covered with a gym, a yoga studio, a boxing studio, an outdoor yoga zone, and a serene steam and sauna suite. For social and family time there is a cinema room, a virtual reality area, an honesty bar, a BBQ area, shaded outdoor seating, indoor and outdoor kids areas, and a collaboration space with meeting rooms.

Inside, the residences make the most of natural light, with efficient layouts and clean-lined finishes that feel calm and genuinely liveable. Warm timber panelling, soft neutral tones and elegant joinery carry through the living, dining and sleeping spaces, creating homes that look considered rather than merely decorated. Kitchens are integrated into the living areas with handsome cabinetry and generous storage, and every detail has been chosen with quality, functionality and long-term durability in mind.

##### Location description and benefits

Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) is a visionary and ambitious community designed to be a dynamic and sustainable urban development that embraces innovation, luxury, and a high quality of life. MBR City is also characterized by its extensive green spaces and beautifully landscaped parks. With a focus on sustainability and environmental conservation, the community incorporates vast stretches of parks, gardens, and waterfront promenades. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, outdoor activities, and moments of tranquility in these serene and scenic surroundings.

The community of MBR City goes beyond residential offerings. It boasts world-class amenities and attractions that enrich the lives of residents and visitors alike. From state-of-the-art educational institutions and healthcare facilities to luxury hotels, shopping malls, and entertainment venues, MBR City provides a comprehensive range of services and experiences that cater to every need and desire.

MBR City is designed to foster a sense of community and engagement among its residents. The community hosts various cultural events, sports competitions, and recreational activities that bring people together, encouraging social interactions and creating a vibrant atmosphere. Additionally, the community features cycling tracks, jogging trails, and equestrian facilities, catering to individuals who appreciate an active and outdoor lifestyle.
